basic_info.description: Blocks from Ocean Beach and Golden Gate Park, 1643 43rd Avenue is a stylishly remodeled 3BD/2BA home in the heart of the Sunset. The upper level features a bright living room and open kitchen/dining layout, plus two bedrooms and a full bath. Downstairs, the private primary suite includes a walk-in closet, spa-style bath, and flexible bonus space. Enjoy a large backyard with deck and raised garden beds, a one-car garage with ample storage, and additional driveway parking. Approx. 2,106 sq ft (per graphic artist). Close to shops, dining, and Muni.
